name: emlak-konut-ideathon-api
description: Emlak Konut Ideathon Platform - Backend API

scripts.docker:start: docker run -d --name emlakapi --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:5010:5010 --env-file .env.production --log-opt max-size=10m --log-opt max-file=3 emlakapi
scripts.docker:stop: docker stop emlakapi || true && docker rm emlakapi || true
scripts.docker:full: docker build -t emlakapi . && docker stop emlakapi || true && docker rm emlakapi || true && docker run -d --name emlakapi --restart unless-stopped --network analiz-net -p 127.0.0.1:5010:5010 --env-file .env.production -v $(pwd)/uploads:/usr/src/app/uploads --log-opt max-size=10m --log-opt max-file=3 emlakapi

author: Emlak Konut
